generations.name: First generation
generations.notes: Launch MY2025 on Geely SEA: ~100 kWh pack, DC up to 200 kW, 11 kW AC; Long Range Single Motor (RWD) and Dual Motor (Performance pack from 2026). 2026 cars for North America built in Busan, South Korea; no hardware change reported. 400 V architecture not confirmed on a fetched page. Confidence: medium (researched 2026-11-19, owner review pending). Sources: https://insideevs.com/news/714381/2025-polestar4-specs-pricing-overview/ ; https://insideevs.com/news/761530/2026-polestar-4-us-spec-pricing/
